items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I played with his band at a club... play drums with my Uncle Cookie... I started playing with Cookie and the Seven Sharps

ctx.x: You needed a two-beat and you need a swing—

A swing and something Latin which was always [scats] — it was just terrible. I never heard or seen a Latin band, but I heard it on the radio and everything. And so I did that and then my Uncle Cookie, who had a band called the Seven Sharps, this was when I was in high school, I was 16 then, and I played with his band at a club. My mom actually let me go to this club called the Horseshoe in Springfield, Mass, and play drums with my Uncle Cookie. Now this was an R&B band. And this club, the Horseshoe, you have to…
I was going to say. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
